text_block_list.text: We're at the start of the Classic Triple Crown tour. King Halo readies herself to take on the first challenge: the Satsuki Sho.
She makes her way to the paddock and exchanges a few words with fellow competitor Seiun Sky.
Though seemingly relaxed on the surface, it's clear to King Halo that Seiun Sky is in perfect condition for racing.
Not only does she need to beat Seiun Sky, she needs great results. Her thirst for victory is stronger than ever.
